name: KinderQuest - Animal Detection
summary: "KinderQuest - Animal Detection" is a virtual reality game designed to engage and educate kids as they explore a vibrant, nature-inspired world. In this interactive adventure, players embark on a journey to discover various animals, using a unique photoshoot mechanic. To capture animals, players must focus their view on the creature, and by aiming at teleport points, they can jump to new areas of the virtual environment.
